name: Eliezer (Moses' son)
title: Moses' youngest son
summary: Eliezer was the youngest son of Moses and Zipporah. His name means 'My God is help,' given by Moses because God had helped him escape from Pharaoh. Eliezer is mentioned only briefly in the Bible, but his descendants served as priests and guardians of God's house.

keyEvents.title: Eliezer's Birth and Naming
keyEvents.description: Moses named his son Eliezer ('My God is help') because God had helped him escape from Pharaoh's sword when he fled Egypt.

keyEvents.title: Reunion with Moses
keyEvents.description: Eliezer was brought to Moses by his father-in-law Jethro, along with his mother Zipporah and brother Gershom, at the mountain of God after the exodus from Egypt.

keyEvents.title: Descendants of Eliezer as Guardians
keyEvents.description: Eliezer's son Rehabiah had many sons, and his descendant Shelomith was appointed to guard the holy gifts that King David and the leaders had dedicated to the Lord.

keyEvents.title: The Genealogy in Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Eliezer's lineage is recorded in Chronicles, where it is noted that he had only one son, Rehabiah, but that Rehabiah's sons were very numerous.
